inv.amended: Keep the runtime ban on LAYA-class decision models. Drop the 'parked' runtime pooled-line selection as an open question: tag-and-seed selection over Observations is the runtime answer under P2 (SLM generation is frozen at authoring or at first show, never a decision authority). Keep the advisory authoring gate, but frame it as a lint that ranks lines for a human, not an oracle.
inv.note: Zero-shot 0.362 against a 0.461 baseline is worse than guessing, and near-tie flips break determinism. The ban is right. The risk is only that 'investigate_later' leaves a hole where the line-selection design should be.

Best item here for P4. Corroboration, contradiction, spoof and decay on an integer-confidence Observation table is exactly what makes inference trails legible: the player can see why a rumour is strong (three independent hops) or weak (one spoofed channel). Tie each combination step to a human-readable reason tag so the notebook can show 'why' not just a number. Parents-per-claim cap as a contract test is good. Keep it noisy-OR plus a subtractive contradiction term; do not grow it into a network.

inv.amended: Endorse the principle (considerations read the deciding actor's own Observations) but drop the expected-utility outcome table for NPCs. Use plain belief-conditioned utility terms with a perceived-state input. Keep EU only for rivals, where planning against beliefs about the player is the whole fun. Add deliberate misbelief: an NPC acting on a stale or spoofed Observation is the main source of readable mistakes.
inv.note: Largest unconsidered opportunity. NPCs that act on wrong beliefs produce the observable behaviour the player reverse-engineers (P4). Omniscient NPCs would make every covert action pointless. A full outcome table per NPC is more machinery than the effect justifies.

inv.amended: Ship the closed-form banded hazard only. Show the band plus its top two contributing causes, so the forecast is an inference trail rather than a number. Defer the Bayesian network and keep it parked until self-play shows the closed form fails. Forecast should be fallible by design: the Ship Mind reasons from its own Observations, not ground truth.
inv.note: Qualitative bands fit the unreliable-advisor tone. The CPT-from-self-play idea is clever but premature and adds a hash-check and save-freeze burden for no visible gain.

Offline fitting from deterministic headless rollouts is the right place for learning and fits the existing eval runner. Needs R3B1 (stable per-stream rolls) so fitted constants do not shift when a new roll is added. Player-style counters for the storyteller are cheap and give a visible 'the world noticed how I play' payoff.

Correct. Bit-stability and author-dependent cost are real runtime vetoes, and no player-visible gain over symbolic belief-driven decisions. World models stay out. Offline use remains allowed under INV-E.

routes.amended: Adopt the fixed step and accumulator, but fold it into R3C2 as the kinematics phase rather than a separate route. Cap catch-up steps per frame to avoid a spiral on the 2019 Mac.
routes.note: Tooling payoff (replay, repro) plus a smoothness win. Required for R3C1 to be bit-exact. Epoch-agnostic.

Arrived/Blocked/Interrupted outcomes are the seam where behaviour meets belief: a blocked NPC becomes an Act and an Observation, which is visible in play (the NPC who is late or detours). Unifies waypoint, direct and snap under one contract, which suits P1.

routes.amended: Slots belong in the prop blueprint as data (seat, lean, stand sites with facing), and the final metre is steered. Do not make it a separate movement system. Land it as a producer under R3A2.
routes.note: Player-visible: NPCs sit, lean and stand where props suggest, which reads as life. Data-driven per prop, so pack authors extend it.

Counter-based keyed rolls are the best determinism fix on the list. Adding content in a pack does not reshuffle outcomes, which matters for P1 and P5 because content grows. Also makes eval fits stable.

Needed before Act and Observation slices exist, given the clone-on-every-access store. Holder-keyed buckets fit the 'who knows what' query. Invisible to the player, but without it the inference trail systems stall performance.
Matches the accepted core model (Act, causeActId envelope). Outcomes with a rejection reason also give the notebook and debug log a 'why did that fail' trace, which feeds P4 signposting.

routes.amended: Keep the command log as the primary artifact and the state-hash replay as a test gate. Treat checkpoint saves as an optimisation. Do not promise rebuild-from-log for players until the fixed step and keyed rolls exist.
routes.note: Tooling payoff: golden runs, bug repro, and eval rollouts share one format. Depends on R3A1 and R3B1 to be honest.
Named phases registered by packs is a clean P1 extension point and makes the order testable. Absorbs R3A1's step loop.
Per-slice versioned chunks let packs add slices without breaking saves, and old saves load with defaults. Supports P5, since the model will keep changing.
